judgment.rationale: The diagnostic archive contains a New+ error at the configured template path, and the current shell extension uses single-level directory creation before scanning that path. The exception is caught by submenu creation and explains why the New+ entry does not appear even though the module is enabled and registered.
evidence: The issue reports PowerToys v0.101.2362 on Windows 11 25H2 and supplies a screenshot plus a PowerToys diagnostic ZIP.

The New+ log records `New+ create submenu error: create_directory: The system cannot find the path specified.: "C:\\Users\\Mored4u\\AppData\\Local\\Microsoft\\PowerToys\\NewPlus\\Templates"` on 2026-08-30.
The same diagnostic set shows New+ enabled and its context-menu handler repeatedly registered on 2026-09-23.
Current `shell_context_sub_menu::shell_context_sub_menu` calls `utilities::create_folder_if_not_exist(root)` before constructing `template_folder` and enumerating templates.
Current `newplus::utilities::create_folder_if_not_exist` calls `std::filesystem::create_directory`, which does not create missing parent directories.
Current `shell_context_menu::EnumSubCommands` catches the resulting exception and returns `E_FAIL`, preventing the New+ submenu from being built.
No linked fix, assignee, or duplicate handling is present in the live issue discussion.
judgment.recommended_action: Approve a focused New+ fix design: create the complete configured template directory tree, preserve safe shell-extension error handling, and add regression coverage for a missing parent path.

fix_assessment.rationale: No existing fix attempt covers Issue 50748. The failure is applicable to PowerToys code and has a concrete root cause in New+ template-folder initialization.

proposed_fixes.title: Create the complete New+ template directory tree before building the submenu
proposed_fixes.root_cause: New+ uses single-level `std::filesystem::create_directory` for the configured template path. When an auto-update or fresh profile leaves the `NewPlus` parent directory absent, directory creation throws; submenu enumeration then returns `E_FAIL`, so Explorer cannot display New+.
plan: Change the New+ folder initialization helper to create all missing parent directories for the configured template path and to treat an already-existing directory as success.
Keep submenu construction from throwing for normal missing-directory initialization, while preserving the existing outer error boundary for genuine filesystem failures.

Add regression coverage that starts with a nested template path whose parent directories do not exist, opens the Explorer context menu, and verifies the New+ submenu is present and empty rather than absent.
Retain the existing template enumeration and default-template behavior after the directory tree is created.
verification: Run the focused NewPlus UI test project covering template-location creation and context-menu visibility.
Reproduce with a configured path whose `NewPlus` parent is absent; start or reload PowerToys, open an Explorer folder background context menu, and verify New+ appears with the Open templates command.
Add a template file after initialization and verify it appears in the New+ submenu and can still create a new file.
Verify an unrelated inaccessible or invalid template path still produces a logged failure rather than silently reporting a healthy menu.

confidence.rationale: The supplied log identifies the exact failing API and path, the current source has the corresponding single-level creation call, and the caller's error handling directly matches the reported missing-menu symptom.

issue_context.summary: The reporter says New+ does not appear after an auto-update on v0.101.2362. The diagnostic archive shows that New+ is enabled and registered, but one submenu construction attempt fails while creating the configured Templates directory because its parent path is missing.
known_information: The reporter supplied version v0.101.2362, the auto-update installation channel, Windows 11 25H2 Home Edition, a screenshot, and a PowerToys diagnostic ZIP.
The issue body does not contain numbered reproduction steps; the only upstream discussion reply asks the reporter to provide concrete steps.
The general settings report has NewPlus enabled.
New+ logs show successful context-menu registration and enable/disable transitions on 2026-09-23.
The New+ settings report points TemplateLocation at `C:\\Users\\Mored4u\\AppData\\Local\\Microsoft\\PowerToys\\NewPlus\\Templates`.
The New+ log records a `create_directory` failure for that exact path because the system cannot find the path.
The current source creates the template path with `std::filesystem::create_directory` and then scans it during submenu construction.
A related older issue, 49316, reports missing templates but has no diagnostic evidence or linked fix; it does not establish duplicate handling for this issue.
inferences: The missing New+ entry is likely caused by submenu construction failing before Explorer receives the submenu, rather than by the module's enabled state or registration.

The failure is most likely triggered when an update or profile transition leaves one or more parent directories absent; this is an evidence-supported mechanism, not a confirmed reproduction of the reporter's exact sequence.
The existing `create_directory` call may work when the parent already exists, which explains why the defect can be intermittent or specific to a fresh/updated installation.
issue_context.analysis: The public evidence is sufficient for a focused fix design. The log names the failing filesystem operation and path, and source inspection shows the same operation occurs immediately before template enumeration. The outer `EnumSubCommands` catch converts that exception to `E_FAIL`, so Explorer receives no New+ submenu. Replacing single-level creation with complete directory-tree creation addresses the failing mechanism without changing template sorting, filtering, or file creation behavior.
initial_investigation: Read the complete live issue body and its only comment through source_updated_at 2026-09-23T14:54:53Z.
Downloaded and inspected the public diagnostic archive, including the New+ settings, New+ shell-extension logs, and runner logs.

Confirmed the New+ log's path-creation error and separately confirmed that runner JSON errors were for FancyZones and Hosts, not New+; the automated triage summary overstated those as New+ configuration errors.
Inspected `src/modules/NewPlus/NewShellExtensionContextMenu/shell_context_sub_menu.cpp`, `shell_context_menu.cpp`, `new_utilities.h`, `template_folder.cpp`, and the New+ UI test suite.
Checked recent New+ history and found the folder helper unchanged since the original New+ implementation; no linked public fix or assigned owner is present.

design.root_cause: During New+ submenu construction, `shell_context_sub_menu::shell_context_sub_menu` obtains the configured template path and calls `newplus::utilities::create_folder_if_not_exist`. That helper uses `std::filesystem::create_directory`, which only creates the final directory when its parent already exists. For the reported path, the missing `NewPlus` parent causes a filesystem exception. `shell_context_menu::EnumSubCommands` catches the exception and returns `E_FAIL`, so Explorer cannot display the New+ submenu.
evidence: Observed in the public diagnostic: `New+ create submenu error: create_directory: The system cannot find the path specified` for the reported Templates path.
Observed in `shell_context_sub_menu.cpp`: directory creation occurs before `template_folder::rescan_template_folder` and menu-item creation.
Observed in `shell_context_menu.cpp`: submenu-construction exceptions are logged and converted to `E_FAIL`.
Observed in the diagnostic: New+ is enabled and its context-menu handler registers successfully, so registration alone does not explain the missing menu.

affected_files.purpose: Shared New+ filesystem/settings helpers used while building the Explorer submenu.
Creates and enumerates the New+ submenu contents.
Exposes the New+ root Explorer command and handles submenu-construction failures.
Windows UI regression coverage for module state, template-folder creation, submenu contents, and template invocation.
New+ UI-test setup and Explorer menu assertions.

implementation_steps.current_behavior: The helper calls single-level `std::filesystem::create_directory(path)` and lets filesystem exceptions escape.
implementation_steps.change: Create the complete directory tree with `std::filesystem::create_directories`, or an equivalent error-code-aware implementation that reports failure explicitly. Preserve success when the final path already exists as a directory, and do not treat a file occupying the path as a valid template root.
edge_cases: An existing directory must remain a successful no-op.
A file at the configured template path must remain an explicit failure and must not be silently replaced.
Access-denied, malformed, or unavailable paths must still reach the existing New+ logging boundary.
The helper runs while Explorer builds a shell menu, so the implementation should avoid unbounded retries or UI-blocking recovery.
tests: Exercise a nested template path with missing parent directories and verify the path is created.
Exercise an existing template directory and verify no duplicate or destructive behavior occurs.
Exercise a path occupied by a file and verify the failure is logged and does not claim a usable submenu.

implementation_steps.current_behavior: The constructor creates the configured root, immediately scans it, and populates the submenu. A creation failure aborts the entire constructor.
implementation_steps.change: Keep the existing ordering, but rely on the complete-tree helper so a missing parent is repaired before `template_folder::rescan_template_folder`. If initialization still fails for a genuinely unusable path, preserve the exception so `EnumSubCommands` logs the failure rather than presenting misleading template entries.
edge_cases: Do not change template ordering, variable filtering, or the Open templates command.
Do not swallow failures that would make later directory iteration unsafe.
Keep the existing shell-extension lifetime and COM command enumeration behavior unchanged.
tests: Open Explorer with a newly created nested template path and assert the New+ root and submenu are visible.
Add a template after initialization and assert it appears without restarting the shell extension.

implementation_steps.current_behavior: The existing location test relies on the Settings folder picker to create the selected directory, so it does not cover submenu-time creation when one or more ancestors are absent.
implementation_steps.change: Add a regression case that writes a nested, non-existent template path into New+ settings, removes the parent tree before opening Explorer, enables New+, and verifies the context menu is present with an empty template list. Reuse the existing setup and menu assertions.
edge_cases: The test must isolate its path under the test suite root and clean it up in the existing test lifecycle.
The assertion must distinguish an empty but present submenu from a missing New+ root command.
Keep the test non-parallel with the existing New+ suite because Explorer registration and settings are shared.
tests: Run the NewPlus UI test project and confirm the new missing-parent case passes.
Retain the existing file, folder, deletion, and module-enable tests as regression coverage for normal paths.

verify: Build the New+ shell extension and the existing NewPlus UI test project using the repository's established test/build workflow; discover the exact invocation from the NewPlus.UITests project and CI configuration if implementation changes the project layout.
Start from a profile where the configured template path has missing ancestors, enable New+, open an Explorer background context menu, and verify New+ appears with Open templates.
Place a file in the newly created Templates directory, reopen the submenu, and verify the file appears and can be instantiated.
Verify an invalid or access-denied template path still produces a New+ diagnostic error and does not silently show an incorrect template list.
risks: Creating parent directories changes behavior for custom template locations that were previously invalid only because an ancestor was absent; this is the intended repair but should remain limited to the configured New+ path.
The helper executes in Explorer's shell-extension process, so filesystem operations must remain bounded and error reporting must not block the shell.
A path collision with a file must not be converted into a directory or silently ignored.
alternatives: Only catch the exception in `shell_context_sub_menu` and show an empty menu. Rejected because it hides the recoverable missing-parent condition and leaves the configured template path unusable.
Ask the reporter to manually create the parent directories. Rejected because the public log identifies a deterministic product initialization gap that can be repaired safely.

Change template enumeration to tolerate a missing root without creating it. Rejected because New+ already promises a usable template location and the existing Settings flow expects the directory to exist.

actions.label: Design fix
actions.description: Approve the fork-side New+ directory-initialization fix design for Issue 50748.
actions.note: Approval starts the fork-side implementation workflow only; it does not write to the upstream repository.

adversary.signoff: The public log, current source, and existing UI-test surface align on the missing-parent directory mechanism. No blocking objection remains to the proposed directory-tree initialization fix.
non_blocking_notes: The reporter's exact numbered reproduction sequence is still absent, but it is not required to choose or verify this narrowly evidenced root cause.
The implementation should retain explicit logging for paths that fail for reasons other than missing ancestors.
